verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Grafana serves an llms.txt at grafana.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled "Grafana documentation"). They also confirm machine-readable markdown versions of its docs (e.g. /docs/grafana/latest/.md), and many docs pages in the pack resolve at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how the llms.txt/markdown docs are meant to be used by agents, and independent community corroboration of agents consuming them in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://grafana.com/llms.txt # Grafana documentation
